snippet.title: Mik Relase Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Mik on steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2547010/Mik/
Join the discord: https://discord.gg/VYUedn5bWE 
Presskit: https://drive.google.com/drive/u/1/folders/1UYTSoEEEbKXXKGkpKPuvfwdT_e_l8yh_

Game & Music by me
VA: @HolidayVA 

Mik is a narrative first-person platformer set inside a decaying megastructure. Traverse through ruined architecture, solve environmental puzzles, and descend into the depths of a dying world to uncover an unsettling truth.
